$comment: Single source of truth for weekday coding and ink partnering. CSS build emits .d-mon…d-sun; canvas and PDF renderers import this file directly (decided 18.08.26 — renderers may not read CSS custom properties).
$neverPairNote: ADVISORY, not a guard (decided 19.08.26). The partner map is canon and supplies every default; these four combinations are discouraged and should warn in a picker, but remain authorable — a deliberate near-tonal overprint is allowed at large scale on stock. Do not lint as an error.
onRule: Text on a palette fill, by APCA (5.10.26, Donald): INK on the two light fills (yellow, amber); CREAM on red, pink, blue, green and purple — Day and Night (the lifted Night purple #9a4faa takes cream too). APCA |Lc| cream/ink: yellow 16/87, amber 34/71, red 71/36, pink 70/37, blue 55/51, green 56/50, purple 92/14 (night 78/29). WCAG 2 ratios favour ink on red/pink/blue/green but misjudge saturated mid-tones.
